newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee weather turning colder but no frost.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee weather turning colder but no frost.

text.p: A strong cold front will come northward out of Argentina during the next few days, bringing the coolest weather of the early season to Brazil's coffee belt, but no damaging cold is expected, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.

In its forecast for Thursday WSC predicted scattered showers and thunderstorms of 0.25-0.75 inch, heavier locally. It will be fair to partly cloudy on Friday as temperatures trend colder. On Thursday morning lows will be in the 50s and 60's Fahrenhrit, falling to 40s to mid 50s on Friday morning.

The outlook is for fair to partly cloudy weather on Saturday and cold again with lows in the 40s to low 50s. It will be partly to variably cloudy with a threat of a few very light showers Sunday and Monday. Temperatures will then turn milder.
East-central Brazil will be dry on Thursday withl highs of 73-86 Fahrenheit.
